P_0x00BA49: Director of <Project TD>. Once a <DC> robotics engineer, he co-founded the Lion series. After DC's fall he continued the project under Federation oversight, but grieves that Series 77 serves military ends. Mild and earnest, he has many friends.
P_0x00BC0E: Helped Kyle and Jiji develop the <AMN System> and ODE system. Once an excellent researcher under Dr. Wilhelm V. Jurgen, she joined the project at his request.
P_0x00BD39: A man-machine interface researcher on the Zentrl Project, involved in Wendigo's development.
P_0x00BDF8: Guardian of Shine, princess of Rixent. The tomboyish Shine gives her trouble, but she watches over her, scolding and caring in turn.
P_0x00BEDB: A <Mao Industries> executive and Rio's father. Co-founded Mao with Lin's father, now her right hand. Overprotective of his daughter, who joined the military against his wishes.
P_0x00C035: A young tycoon: shipper, promoter, broker, hotel owner, ex-boxing champ, with underworld ties. An old friend of Ratsel, he supplies the Kurogane. Runs the "AM Battling" circuit and owns a custom Guarlion.
